what_this_is: Five paired interleaved repeats of three admission rules against a scrubbed control, on the three TTF-1 cells the earlier arms sweep used. It was designed to settle whether the gain tracks the NUMBER of windows a plan attaches -- `density` and `reuse_order` commit the same bytes and hold the same bytes resident while differing 30 windows to 4 on the golden trace. IT DID NOT SETTLE THAT: on the device all three arms attached 48 windows. What it did produce is the cleanest noise measurement this repository has, because one of the three arms is a null control.

findings.finding: The experiment did not vary what it was designed to vary.
findings.detail: `windows_attached_to_node` is 48 for `density`, 48 for `reuse_order` and 48 for `survival`. On tests/golden/trace_live_c1.json the two rules emit 29 and 15 persist actions -- but over the SAME 15 distinct kernels, and what reaches the device is one access-policy window per kernel node. The design was read off a plan's action count and the device counts kernels. Nothing here is evidence for or against the window-count reading of the 0.2.1 arms sweep; a next attempt has to pick arms that differ in `windows_attached_to_node` and check that counter BEFORE spending the box.

findings.finding: Two byte-identical plans differ by more than most results this project has reported.
findings.detail:
`survival` and `density` compile to the same plan -- identical digests on all four golden traces, asserted by tests/test_golden.cpp -- so the paired difference between them is pure noise with the policy held constant. Measured over five interleaved repeats: median -0.145% at ctx128-c1, -0.045% at ctx128-c4, +0.230% at ctx128-c16, with peak-to-peak 0.145%, 0.501% and 1.290%.

At ctx128-c1 the -0.145% is exactly one least-significant digit of the bench's own output (0.1 of 69.2 tok/s), so that cell's arm-to-arm floor is set by the printer. At ctx128-c16 it is not: 0.230% of 564 tok/s is 1.3 tok/s against a 0.018% print resolution.

The consequence is the point. That cell's persist-family ceiling is 0.249%. Two arms running the SAME plan differ by 0.230% there. No admission rule can be distinguished from another in that cell by this instrument, which is what `tools/tt-frontier generation show TTF-1 --reachable` says from arithmetic alone.

findings.finding: The shipped family is a resolved regression at one and four sequences.
findings.detail: `density` against the control: -0.289% median at ctx128-c1 with all five repeats negative, -0.544% median at ctx128-c4 with all five negative and peak-to-peak 0.542%, and +0.106% median at ctx128-c16 straddling zero from -0.301% to +0.231%. `reuse_order` and `survival` agree within their own floor at every cell. Three admission rules, one answer: the family costs about half a point where it can be measured at all.
